tops.title: Shirts, T-shirts and polos
tops.unitNote: Body measurements. Measure over a T-shirt, keeping the tape level and snug, not tight.

belts.title: Belts
belts.unitNote: Choose your trouser waist size. The belt size is the length to the middle hole.

howToMeasure: Under the arms, around the fullest part of the chest.
Around the base of the neck, with one finger under the tape.
Around your natural waist, just above the hip bones.
